prompt:
Five review findings against the model catalog. Fix all of them.

1. A corrupt `models-dev.json` cache makes `initModelCatalog` throw before the catalog is applied, so a valid cached Nebius catalog is not used. A cache that cannot be read must count as a miss.
2. Launch waits on models.dev: when that cache is missing or more than a day old, startup awaits the fetch even though a fresh Nebius catalog cache exists. Launch must never wait on models.dev: use whatever cache exists and refresh it in the background.
3. Models that cannot call tools are hidden from the picker, which also broke an explicit `--model <id>` for them, because `resolveClaudeModel` and `resolveCodexModel` only search the picker list. An explicit id must fall back to the full live catalog. An id that exists nowhere must still throw the "Unsupported" error.
4. The tool-calling filter skips curated models. It must apply to every model: a curated model whose live row has no tool support is left out of `selectable` but stays in `byId`.
5. Ordering falls back to models.dev's `last_updated` when `release_date` is missing, so a metadata edit can outrank a real release. Only `release_date` counts; a model without one is undated.

This is a pnpm monorepo. Run one test file with `cd packages/tests && node_modules/.bin/vitest run src/<file>.test.ts`; do not run the whole suite. packages/cli imports @nconnect/models from its build output, so after changing packages/models run `node_modules/.bin/tsc -p packages/models/tsconfig.json` from the repository root. Dependencies are already installed: never run pnpm, npm or any install command. Do not bump versions or edit CHANGELOG or the site/ folder.
